# AppMap

AppMap is the runtime-context layer for AI coding agents. It records how your
code actually runs and serves that trace to any AI coding agent over the
Model Context Protocol (MCP). Free, open source, local-only.

## What it does
- Traces a running application or test suite without code changes.
- Exposes the trace to any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub
  Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Google Antigravity) through a few high-density
  queries: get_call_tree, find_calls, find_queries, find_requests.
- Renders the same trace to developers as a dependency map, sequence
  diagram, call tree, flame graph, OpenAPI diff, and runtime code review.

## Why it matters
In a controlled internal study (Claude Sonnet 4.6 + Haiku 4.5, not yet
independently replicated), agents with runtime context held 100% root-cause
accuracy under a 3-call diagnostic budget where static-analysis agents fell
to 28%. The runtime lane reached the same verified-fix rate for ~3.4× less
inference spend.

- Benchmarks: https://appmap.io/benchmarks
